description: This file defines the package Mail::Address, providing functionality for parsing, formatting, and extracting components from email address strings. It includes methods for handling email address parsing, name extraction, address formatting, and component access.

classes.name: Mail::Address
classes.description: Main class representing an email address, with methods for parsing, formatting, and extracting components.

methods.name: _extract_name
methods.description: Attempts to extract a person's name from a comment or phrase.

methods.name: _tokenise
methods.description: Tokenizes an email address string into meaningful components.

methods.name: _find_next
methods.description: Finds the next significant token in a list of tokens.

methods.name: _complete
methods.description: Creates a new Mail::Address object from parsed components.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor to create a new Mail::Address object with provided data.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string or list of strings into a Mail::Address object or objects.

methods.name: phrase
methods.description: Accessor for the phrase component of the email address.

methods.name: set_or_get
methods.description: Generic method to set or get value in object array.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats address components into a properly formatted email address string.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Extracts the display name from the address components.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host part of the email address.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the user part of the email address.
